## Summary

Describe what this pull request changes and why.

## Scope

List the affected API, algorithm, platform, build logic, documentation, or tooling.

## Validation

Describe the validation performed. Include relevant test targets, KATs, sanitizer runs, interoperability checks, compiler/platform checks, or benchmarks. For documentation-only changes, state that no cryptographic build/test execution is required.

## Portability / security impact

Describe any relevant assumptions or changes involving integer width, endianness, ABI, compiler behavior, timing behavior, memory handling, randomness, validation, or failure semantics. Write `None` if not applicable.

## Checklist

- [ ] I did not include credentials, private keys, API keys, proprietary source, or unrelated private data.
- [ ] Public API or user-facing behavior changes are documented where applicable.
- [ ] New or changed cryptographic behavior is backed by appropriate standards/references and validation.
- [ ] Portability implications were considered for supported modern, legacy, and non-mainstream environments.
- [ ] Security-sensitive changes do not silently weaken existing validation, failure handling, or timing policy.
